messages:
deploybot: preflight check failed for release/2026.03.20 - blocking promotion to PROD. Issues: PROD missing `MODEL_PIN` (secret not found) and `KVCACHE_PREFIX` differs from staging. deploylog: `envdiff --staging --prod | grep -E "MODEL_PIN|KVCACHE_PREFIX"`

alex: ugh. we planned to remove pinned model for dynamic fallback. did prod never get the helm change? @priya are you able to check the values in prod config?

priya: checking now. quick find: staging helm values show `MODEL_PIN: ''` and `KVCACHE_PREFIX: infer-cache-202403`. prod values show `MODEL_PIN: v1.8.2` and `KVCACHE_PREFIX: infer-cache-202402`. looks like prod still has the old pin.

sam: that KVCACHE_PREFIX mismatch is scary — changing prefix will invalidate a bunch of cached kv entries. if we flip without coordination we'll spike cold-cache latency and cost.

anya: options: 1) backfill prod to empty pin (risky—changes routing), 2) pin staging back to v1.8.2 and promote (safe), 3) abort promotion and schedule migration with cache-rotate. which do we prefer?

ops-lee: release window closes in 18m. my vote is to pin staging back to `v1.8.2` and promote, then schedule a migration window for cache prefix rotation. we shouldn't invalidate prod cache in-window.

alex: +1. also we need release notes explicitly calling out the model-pin removal and cache-prefix migration. add an operational step to run `kvcache-prefix-rotate --dry-run` before any prefix change.

priya: fwiw helm templating revealed another mismatch: staging references secret `inference-model-pin-secret` while prod references `model-pin`. deploybot is blocking because `model-pin` secret doesn't include the expected key (or is absent).

sam: that explains it. secret-name canonicalization bite. we should not create an alias in prod without a compliance ticket.

ops-lee: agreed — don't silently create secret aliases. prefer restoring parity by pinning staging. we'll open a compliance note for any secret renaming.

anya: please hold promotion. can someone trigger a rollback of the canary? we don't want partial traffic on mixed configs.

deploybot: Rollback initiated for release/2026.03.20 at 2799991118. Canary pods terminated and traffic routed back to previous stable. (reacted with :white_check_mark:)

alex: thanks. priya, create a short rollback entry for the changelog: reason = env parity (secret name mismatch + kvcache prefix drift). also add a follow-up to strengthen preflight checks.

priya: will draft the release note and a runbook for migration. assigning owners: priya / sam / ops-lee. ETA for doc: ~45m.

sam: action item: extend deploybot preflight to detect secret-name mismatches and surface `KVCACHE_PREFIX` differences as critical (not warning). i'll prototype a check.

ops-lee: i'll schedule a 2-hour migration/change window next Tue 07:00 UTC and add the compliance ticket for any secret renames.

deploybot: noted. release status: ON HOLD.

alex: also add `release-check --strict-env` to weekly CI so we catch these parity drifts sooner.

priya: noted, opening postmortem ticket with steps and owners now.
